posts.title: Repair: 1 Nikkor 11-27.5mm f/3.5-5.6
posts.description: Hello, everybody! Hello, everybody! Do you know that there are times when doing less is more? There is an old Taoist concept of wuwei (無為) which literally means “ doing nothing ” in the sense that you’re just waiting for things to unfold on its own. This can sometimes be translated as “ inaction ” depending on who your reading. Doing nothing does not mean you are lazy, it can mean that you are just waiting for the right time to take action, if any opportunity ever comes at all. The closest thing I could think of is just saying “ the kids will be fine ” in the anglophone world. Sometimes, doing less or doing nothing is actually doing more. It isn’t risky and you won’t be blamed for anything. This can also be applied to engineering as well and you shall soon see why I said that. Introduction: The 1 Nikkor 11-27.5mm f/3.5-5.6 is the predecessor of the 1 Nikkor 10-30mm f/3.5-5.6 VR but it wasn’t produced as much so you don’t see them as much as the latter. posts.description: Hello, everybody! Have you ever been in a situation where you thought you have gotten a good deal but you just realized that you have been screwed? Life is mostly fair, you do not win all the time, nor should you lose all the way. There is always something for you at the end, good or bad. That is just the nature of things and is the natural order of the universe. My readers know that I do not win all the time in my camera repair adventure, sometimes my projects don’t go as smoothly as expected due to defects or because of some idiot getting to the camera before me. Today, I will show you what I meant by that but you must read the article carefully in order to know exactly why. Introduction: We’ve talked about our Gucci -wearing broke friend that is the Hansa Canon in the previous article. It is interesting to see what is inside of such a rare camera and even more interesting to for us is the workmanship. posts.title: Repair: Hansa Canon (part 1)
posts.description: Hello, everybody! Do you have that friend who always dresses nicely but is actually cheap? He is not cheap because he is frugal but he is cheap because he has nothing much to his name! I had such a friend and he was a miserable piece of work because he is the type of bastard who would eat all the good bits at a dinner but disappears when it is time to pay the bill! Not only that, he is the biggest poser out there, acting like he pays for everyone. Frankly, I am the generous type, I just can’t stand being close to people like him that’s why I told him to bugger off. Today, I will show you one such camera. It looks nice outside but is kind of a mess in the interior. It’s trying to present itself as something it isn’t, but unlike the dork that I mentioned this was all necessary because it’s the first of the many production cameras that the brand ever produced.
